events.title: Wheat Ridge Holiday Celebration 2026 — Horse-Drawn Carriage, Trackless Train and Hands-On Holiday Crafts
events.time: 3:00–6:30 p.m. MST; free first-come Santa photo tickets distributed starting 2:45 p.m.; tree lighting 6:15 p.m.
events.location: The Green at 38th and surrounding businesses, 7101 W 38th Ave, Wheat Ridge, CO 80033, USA
events.cost: City-sponsored event with free public admission; 2 adults + 3 children $0 entry. Free seated Santa photos with limited first-come tickets. Individual hayride/carriage/trackless train charges, if any, not specified on official event page; meals/purchases extra.
events.age: All-age family community event; open public attendance with no residency requirement stated; limited first-come Santa tickets.
events.description: One afternoon of actual horse-drawn carriage/hay rides, trackless mini-train rides, cookie and ornament craft activities, s'mores with firefighters, family photos, and student choir at a city-hosted public celebration; these are in the official 2026 activity listing, not just ordinary markets or performances. Public municipal volunteer page confirms event is free. Arrive before 2:45 p.m. if interested in limited free Santa photo ticket, not an event-entry ticket. 2026 event for local Colorado contacts. Official event page does not itemize ride fees; do not claim all rides free. Relevant official source also https://rootedinfun.com/162/Volunteer.

events.title: Littleton 2026 Candlelight Walk — One-Night Free Parade, Drone Show and Santa/Reindeer Visits
events.time: 5:00–8:00 p.m. MST; parade 6:30 p.m.; drone show approximately 7:00–7:15 p.m.; Santa photos 5:00–6:00 and 7:15–8:00 p.m.
events.location: Downtown Main Street, between Bega Park and The Melting Pot, Littleton, CO 80120, USA
events.cost: No admission ticket or required attendee registration for public Main Street parade/drone viewing; estimated mandatory admission for family of five $0; official page explicitly offers free Santa photos, complimentary cocoa/cider, and free parking at Littleton Center or Arapahoe Community College. Optional food/keepsakes additional.
events.age: Open public street celebration for all ages; no residency condition or restricted credential published.
events.description: A single evening 2026 downtown celebration featuring an organized evening parade, Santa and real reindeer visits, city-supported music-synchronized drone show after the 6:30 p.m. parade, free Santa photos, and complimentary hot cocoa/cider. Drone show is weather-dependent; the official host gives exact parade/show timing, public street venue and free parking. Different from the existing daily Denver 600-drone show, and has uniquely combined parade/reindeer activities. 2026-only Colorado local contact opportunity, not a 2027 event; no ticket purchase or on-site paid ride required.
